# `vague-type-name`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: strict · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports type names containing generic words that do not describe a domain role.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Names such as generic containers or holders force readers to inspect
implementation details to understand responsibility.

## When it fires

Enable the strict profile for codebases that want domain-specific public and
internal type vocabulary.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
pub const Context = struct { key: u32 };
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#Avoid-Redundancy-in-Names>
